title: Alacrity Slow Your Roll/Bronze Compatability Pack
description: This resource pack adds visual compatibility between the Alacrity resource pack by Satellence and the mods Slow Your Roll & Bronze
body:
This is a pack to add visual compatability between the resource pack Alacrity by Satellence and the mods Slow Your Roll, Bronze, Slow Your Bronze, and Horseman.

Continuity mod is required for connected tin glass textures, and obviously Alacrity is highly recommended.

This pack contains both original textures and modified versions of Alacrity's textures, with explicit permission from the author of Alacrity. All non-original textures belong to them.

Using this addon in modpacks is allowed. But, you may not redistribute or modify any of the textures in this pack. If you wish to create your own addons for Alacrity using any of Satellence's textures you must contact them on discord. There is a link on the Alacrity modrinth page.
